segments.sub: What if friction disappeared... for ten seconds?
segments.tts: What if friction disappeared... for ten seconds?

segments.sub: Friction is the force that stops things from sliding. You use it every single time you take a step.
segments.tts: Friction is the force that stops things from sliding. You use it every single time you take a step.

segments.sub: Without it, the ground becomes perfect ice. Your foot pushes back... and just slips.
segments.tts: Without it, the ground becomes perfect ice. Your foot pushes back... and just slips.

segments.sub: If you were already moving, you'd keep going. Nothing could slow you down.
segments.tts: If you were already moving, you'd keep going. Nothing could slow you down.

segments.sub: Every knot would untie. Shoelaces, ropes, even the knots in your hair.
segments.tts: Every knot would untie. Shoelaces, ropes, even the knots in your hair.

segments.sub: Nails and screws would slide right out of the wood. Fences and furniture would fall apart.
segments.tts: Nails and screws would slide right out of the wood. Fences and furniture would fall apart.

segments.sub: You couldn't hold anything. Your food would squirt right out of your hands.
segments.tts: You couldn't hold anything. Your food would squirt right out of your hands.

segments.sub: Then friction comes back, all at once. Everything that was sliding stops... instantly.
segments.tts: Then friction comes back, all at once. Everything that was sliding stops... instantly.

segments.sub: Ten seconds, and the whole world ends up on the floor.
segments.tts: Ten seconds, and the whole world ends up on the floor.
